source: Armagedom origin/main Web/public/assets/rat/rat-king.glb (24-bone rat rig: root > pelvis > spine > chest > neck > head > jaw > bite_tip; pelvis > tail_1..tail_4; pelvis > leg_B[LR] > shin > paw; chest > leg_F[LR] > shin > paw). World rest position of every bone, from the GLB node JSON only (translations composed down the parents, no mesh read; the armature and root nodes carry no rotation or scale). Model units, before the model scale the game applies (data/bodies/rat-king.chain.json scale). The creature faces +z, stands on y = 0, its spine runs along z. Left is -x here (leg_BL x -0.048).
units: glb model units (metres before the game's model scale)

bbox_model_units.source: extent of the bone points only (paw_BL to bite_tip and tail_4), not the mesh
